nodes.summary: For $m \in \mathbb{N}$, the cells of the Aztec diamond region of order $m$ are the pairs of integers $(i, j)$ with $|2i + 1| + |2j + 1| \le 2m$. The pair $(i, j)$ stands for the unit square with lower-left corner $(i, j)$ and center $(i + \frac12, j + \frac12)$, so the condition says that this center satisfies $|i + \frac12| + |j + \frac12| \le m$.
nodes.title: Cells of the Aztec diamond

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the dragon graph of order $n$ (the spanning subgraph of the Aztec diamond graph $AD_{2n}$ that keeps exactly the edges of weight $1$ under Ciucu's periodic weight $\mathrm{wt}_A$) has exactly $2^{n(n+1)}$ perfect matchings.
nodes.title: Perfect matchings of the Aztec dragon graph (Ciucu, Wieland)

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $n$ the dragon graph of order $n$ (the spanning subgraph of the Aztec diamond graph $AD_{2n}$ that keeps exactly the edges of weight $1$ under Ciucu's periodic weight $\mathrm{wt}_A$) has exactly $2^{n(n+1)}$ perfect matchings. This is Propp's Problem 15 in the form of Ciucu's (7.1) and Theorem 7.1 at $a = 1$.
nodes.title: Propp's Aztec dragon count

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
